The Eternal Game of Celestial Wisdom.
Golf Gita blends the art of golf with the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, guiding readers through ego, duality and balance towards inner clarity, purposeful action and freedom beyond the scorecard.
Golf gives you 18 holes and four hours to confront yourself. The Bhagavad Gita gives you 18 chapters and a battlefield. The problems are identical. So are the solutions.

Golf Gita is a personal journal and guided exploration of golf’s inner game through the wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita. It is neither a technical golf manual nor a final authority on the Gita. Its 18 holes offer mirrors for ego, fear, desire, balance and awareness, not a fixed sequence of lessons. Read in order or turn to what speaks to you today. The course has numbers. The mind does not.
Please increase character limit. Increase and match font size to paragraph 1

This book does not argue the coincidence. It works through it, hole by hole. Each chapter opens with the teaching most needed at that point in a round, then shows where the Gita said the same thing, two thousand years earlier.
